# SlainteTech: Clinical Safety, Revenue Integrity & Healthcare API Security Platform

Canonical Website: https://slainte-tech.com/

> SlainteTech delivers 16 specialized clinical safety, hospital revenue integrity, governance, and API cybersecurity modules built directly on HL7 FHIR R4 across 8 healthcare verticals (desktop, ward tablet, ambulance ePCR, and mobile care-at-home nursing).

## Core Clinical & Security Architecture
- **Rule-Based Clinical Calculations**: Royal College of Physicians NEWS2 (0-20), Manchester Triage System (Cat 1-5), and 3-Tier Pharmacology (Allergy cross-reactivity, ISMP High-Alert DDI, LOINC eGFR & Potassium renal gating) execute 100% in verified Python code, never guessed.
- **On-Premise & Air-Gap Ready**: Runs inside private hospital VPCs, clinics, or completely offline environments alongside SlainteFHIR (:8082), or connects read-only to existing EHRs via SMART-on-FHIR v2 with GDPR Art. 9 PII redaction.

## 8 Healthcare Industry Verticals (`/verticals/<domain>/`)
- [For Emergency Departments (SlainteED)](/verticals/emergency-departments/): Manchester Triage Cat 1-5, 24h RCP NEWS2 sepsis escalation, 3-Tier Rx-Guard, and cited consultant shift handovers.
- [For General Practitioners & Community Nursing (SlainteGP)](/verticals/general-practice/): Ambient Voice Scribe SOAP notes, HSE Chronic Disease Management, PCRS GMS export, and mobile smartphone/tablet UX for Care-at-Home Nurses.
- [For Psychiatrists & Mental Health (SlaintePsych)](/verticals/psychiatry/): Structured MSE composer, LOINC PHQ-9 (44261-6) & GAD-7 (70274-6) tracking, psychotropic renal/DDI screening, and GDPR Art. 9 compartment isolation.
- [For Dental Surgeons & DSOs (SlainteDent)](/verticals/dentistry/): Interactive 32-tooth FDI Odontogram (11-48), 6-sextant BPE charting, and chairside Penicillin/anticoagulant clearance.
- [For Clinical & Community Pharmacies (SlaintePharm)](/verticals/pharmacy/): Risk-sorted dispensing queue, 3-Tier pharmacology verification, PSI Provenance sign-off, and HSE PCRS claim export.
- [For Ambulance & Paramedic Services (SlainteEMS)](/verticals/ambulance-ems/): Glove-friendly 44px rugged tablet ePCR, sub-10ms MTS/NEWS2 acuity scoring, and 1-tap receiving ED FHIR R4 bundle push.
- [For Elite Sports Clubs & Federations (SlainteSport)](/verticals/sports-medicine/): Squad physiological readiness, SCAT6 concussion SHA-256 Return-to-Play Provenance, TUE screening, and athlete privacy protection.
- [For Astronaut & Aerospace Medicine (SlainteAstro)](/verticals/astronaut-health/): 100% air-gapped onboard medical bay running all clinical safety and compliance modules with zero Earth-cloud dependency.
